BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (no EPS change in FY16-FY25 ex-FY17 ex-FY19 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22 ex-FY24 to measure: the 0% cap); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-5.1%/yr (FY26 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY17 ex-FY19 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22 ex-FY24 median

BULL.desc: EPS +3.0%/yr (FY16-FY25 ex-FY17 ex-FY19 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22 ex-FY24 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +6.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY16-FY25 ex-FY17 ex-FY19 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22 ex-FY24); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: BMY (retrospective, 2026-03-13) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 0.76x (20.4% downside to Bear $47 / +26.9% upside to Bull $75) | Adj composite 2.86 vs market 3.24: gap -0.38 [MODESTLY OVERVALUED] | +14% above the EPP floor $52 (15x FY26E $3.46) | Conservative 2-yr case: +8.3% total (+4.2%/yr) | At 17.1x FY26E the 15% hurdle price $78 sits above the BULL case; U.S. revenues -0.4% in Q4 2025, forward revenues -4.6% to -1.4% (FY26 revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
